description: Source code for the 'File' class managing disk cache file operations, including reading, writing, and file management with asynchronous support.

classes.name: File
classes.description: A class encapsulating file operations for disk cache, supporting synchronous and asynchronous read/write, file validation, length management, and platform-specific file access.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the file with a given path, opening it with read/write flags.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the underlying file handle is valid.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads data from the file at a specified offset into a buffer.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Writes data to the file at a specified offset from a buffer.

methods.name: Read (async)
methods.description: Performs an asynchronous read operation with callback support.

methods.name: Write (async)
methods.description: Performs an asynchronous write operation with callback support.

methods.name: SetLength
methods.description: Sets the length of the file.

methods.name: GetLength
methods.description: Retrieves the current length of the file.

methods.name: WaitForPendingIOForTesting
methods.description: Waits for all pending IO operations to complete, used in testing.

methods.name: DropPendingIO
methods.description: Drops all pending IO operations, static method.

methods.name: DoRead
methods.description: Performs a read operation on a worker thread.

methods.name: DoWrite
methods.description: Performs a write operation on a worker thread.

methods.name: OnOperationComplete
methods.description: Callback invoked upon completion of asynchronous IO.
